evidence_spans: We model a two-dimensional (𝑥, 𝑧) array of 60 slab waveguides of width 4 µm
array of 60 slab waveguides of width 4 µm
We solve Maxwell’s equations with the beam-envelope method of COMSOL Multiphysics
CLM-PHOT-0156.statement: The modeled slab waveguides in the simulated array have a width of 4 µm.

extra_quotes: The amplitudes are evolved with an adaptive Runge-Kutta solver, and the power of a bound state is obtained by projecting the evolving field onto it.
The full-wave simulations of Sec. 3 solve Maxwell’s equations for a two-dimensional array of slab waveguides with the beam-envelope method of COMSOL Multiphysics.
